entities/scrapegraphai.md.answer: ScrapeGraphAI is an open-source Python library and commercial API that takes a URL and a prompt and uses an LLM to return structured data. In the reported tests, results varied between identical runs and prices were hallucinated on listing pages, while GPT-4o and generated BeautifulSoup scrapers worked better, and the open-source version has no anti-bot bypass.

entities/scrapeops.md.title: ScrapeOps: proxy and scraping API service, free tier
entities/scrapeops.md.description: ScrapeOps offers proxies and scraping APIs with a free request tier. The page covers AI-assisted scraper code, Scrapy and curl_cffi pipelines, and its limits.
entities/scrapeops.md.name: ScrapeOps
entities/scrapeops.md.answer: ScrapeOps is a proxy and scraping API service with a free tier of requests, and it uses AI to help write scraping code. It has not been tested by TWSC, and its own material says AI does not handle ongoing site access, site changes, or data accuracy, so heavily protected sites may need extra engineering.

entities/scrapingduck.md.title: ScrapingDuck: scraping API with IP rotation and JS rendering
entities/scrapingduck.md.description: ScrapingDuck is a scraping API with IP rotation, JavaScript rendering, a free daily tier and an API key endpoint returning raw HTML. Not yet tested by TWSC.
entities/scrapingduck.md.name: ScrapingDuck
entities/scrapingduck.md.answer: ScrapingDuck is a scraping API that rotates IP addresses, renders JavaScript, and offers a free tier with a daily limit. Requests are authenticated with an API key and an endpoint returns raw HTML, but TWSC has not tested it, so its success against protected sites is unknown.

entities/scrapingsandbox.md.title: ScrapingSandbox: practice site with 500 sample products
entities/scrapingsandbox.md.description: ScrapingSandbox is a practice site with 500 products, 15 categories and 20 vendors for testing search, filters and pagination with Playwright or Puppeteer.
entities/scrapingsandbox.md.name: ScrapingSandbox
entities/scrapingsandbox.md.answer: ScrapingSandbox is a practice site for learning and testing web scraping, with 500 sample products across 15 categories and 20 vendors. Scrapers can search, filter, and paginate the data using tools like Playwright, Puppeteer, or Agenty AI, though TWSC has not yet tested it.

entities/scrapling.md.title: Scrapling: Python scraping library with stealth fetchers
entities/scrapling.md.description: Scrapling's three fetchers (Fetcher, DynamicFetcher, StealthyFetcher), adaptive parsing, Cloudflare Turnstile in headless mode, and a Nike.com Akamai test.
entities/scrapling.md.name: Scrapling
entities/scrapling.md.answer: Scrapling is a Python scraping library by D4Vinci with three fetchers: Fetcher for TLS-impersonated HTTP, DynamicFetcher on Playwright, and StealthyFetcher on a modified Camoufox. In tests, StealthyFetcher cleared Cloudflare Turnstile headless, and plain Fetcher reached 100% success on 1,000 Akamai-protected Nike URLs.

entities/scrapoxy.md.title: Scrapoxy: open-source proxy aggregator for Scrapy
entities/scrapoxy.md.description: Scrapoxy puts datacenter VMs, residential and mobile proxy providers behind one endpoint. Covers pools, Scrapy middleware, a cost test and limits.
entities/scrapoxy.md.name: Scrapoxy
entities/scrapoxy.md.answer: Scrapoxy is an open-source proxy aggregator that puts multiple proxy providers and cloud VM instances behind one endpoint, so spiders need no provider-specific code. In the reported test, a mixed Scrapy and Playwright fleet cost about 20% less, but cloud datacenter IPs still fail on targets that block cloud ASNs.

entities/scrapy.md.title: Scrapy: Python scraping library and its typical setup
entities/scrapy.md.description: Scrapy is a Python web scraping library. The page covers its role in AI data collection setups with proxy rotation, job schedulers and cloud storage.
entities/scrapy.md.name: Scrapy
entities/scrapy.md.answer: Scrapy is a Python library used in typical web scraping setups, including those built for AI data collection. It usually runs alongside proxy server rotation services, job schedulers for concurrent requests, and cloud storage for collected data. TWSC has not tested it yet.

entities/sec-ch-ua-form-factors.md.title: Sec-CH-UA-Form-Factors: Chrome device type client hint
entities/sec-ch-ua-form-factors.md.description: Sec-CH-UA-Form-Factors is a Chrome 124 client hint reporting device type: Desktop, Automotive, Mobile, Tablet, XR, EInk or Watch. Not yet tested by TWSC.
entities/sec-ch-ua-form-factors.md.name: Sec-CH-UA-Form-Factors
entities/sec-ch-ua-form-factors.md.answer: Sec-CH-UA-Form-Factors is a Chrome client hint, available from version 124 as part of the privacy sandbox, that reports the device type: Desktop, Automotive, Mobile, Tablet, XR, EInk, or Watch. Google found no active fingerprinting risk because the same data is in the user agent, and TWSC has not yet tested it.

entities/selenium-headless-chrome-detect.title: Selenium/Headless Chrome Detection: four bot checks
entities/selenium-headless-chrome-detect.description: Four ways to detect Selenium in headless and non-headless Chrome: user agent, sec-ch-ua header, navigator.webdriver and CDP side effects.
entities/selenium-headless-chrome-detect.name: Selenium/Headless Chrome Detection
entities/selenium-headless-chrome-detect.answer: Selenium/Headless Chrome Detection is a set of four techniques for spotting bots that drive Selenium in headless and non-headless Chrome. They check for HeadlessChrome in the user agent and the sec-ch-ua header, navigator.webdriver set to true, and Chrome DevTools Protocol side effects. TWSC has not tested them yet.

entities/selenium.md.title: Selenium: browser automation for scraping and anti-bot
entities/selenium.md.description: Selenium is an open-source framework that controls browsers via WebDriver. Covers headless mode, rendering bot-detection challenges, and its slowness.
entities/selenium.md.name: Selenium
entities/selenium.md.answer: Selenium is an open-source framework that automates web browsers through a WebDriver interface, commonly used for scraping and testing. Run headless, it can render bot detection challenges and mimic real users, but it is slower and more resource-intensive than dedicated bypass APIs, and TWSC has not tested it yet.

entities/sensecollect.md.title: SenseCollect: self-service scraper with CSV export
entities/sensecollect.md.description: SenseCollect is a self-service scraper for lead generation. Covers the Google Maps leads and Instagram followers tools and the three-step CSV download.
entities/sensecollect.md.name: SenseCollect
entities/sensecollect.md.answer: SenseCollect is a self-service platform for web data extraction aimed at lead generation and market intelligence, with tools such as Google Maps leads and Instagram followers export. The user picks a tool, enters a query, location, and run size, then downloads a CSV. It has not yet been tested by TWSC.

entities/sentinelmcp.md.title: SentinelMCP: MCP policy firewall and token-cost proxy
entities/sentinelmcp.md.description: Stateless firewall in front of MCP servers: origin validation, JWKS-backed JWT checks, 7-day token budgets and spike detection. Not yet tested by TWSC.
entities/sentinelmcp.md.name: SentinelMCP
entities/sentinelmcp.md.answer: SentinelMCP is a stateless policy firewall and token-cost proxy that sits in front of a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and checks every tool call for identity, policy, and budget compliance. It has not been tested by TWSC, so there are no scraping results yet.

entities/shellroute-cli.md.title: shellroute CLI: route shell commands through a proxy
entities/shellroute-cli.md.description: shellroute CLI sends a terminal session or single command through a proxy by country or city, using a local HTTP proxy and proxy environment variables.
entities/shellroute-cli.md.name: shellroute CLI
entities/shellroute-cli.md.answer: The shellroute CLI is a command-line tool that routes a shell session or a single command through a proxy in a chosen country or city, leaving other applications and terminals on their normal connections. It runs each route as a local HTTP proxy using standard proxy environment variables, and TWSC has not tested it yet.

entities/shibuya-waf.md.title: Shibuya WAF: Rust reverse proxy with OWASP CRS rules
entities/shibuya-waf.md.description: Shibuya WAF is a Rust reverse-proxy firewall using the OWASP Core Rule Set, custom rules and Redis rate limiting. Lists its known limitations; not yet tested.
entities/shibuya-waf.md.name: Shibuya WAF
entities/shibuya-waf.md.answer: Shibuya WAF is a Rust reverse proxy that checks every incoming request against the OWASP Core Rule Set and custom rules, with Redis rate limiting and a dashboard. TWSC has not tested it. Known gaps: no response inspection, no XML/SOAP body reading, and request-body DoS protections not compiled.

entities/shomei.md.title: shomei: YubiKey authentication proxy for HTTP and TCP
entities/shomei.md.description: shomei is a Rust proxy that gates HTTP and TCP access with hardware-attested YubiKeys: WebAuthn, CLI assertions, mTLS certificates, and OpenSSH tunneling.
entities/shomei.md.name: shomei
entities/shomei.md.answer: shomei is a Rust-based authentication proxy for HTTP and TCP traffic that uses hardware-attested YubiKeys, with WebAuthn, one-use CLI assertions, and short-lived mTLS certificates. For scraping, it is a gate that needs a YubiKey 5 Series key (firmware 5.7.4 or later), a PIN, and touch. TWSC has not tested it yet.

entities/sibuna.md.title: Sibuna: open-source proof-of-work WAF against bots
entities/sibuna.md.description: Sibuna is an open-source WAF that makes clients solve a proof-of-work puzzle. Covers signed sessions, rate limits, WebAssembly solver and proxy setups.
entities/sibuna.md.name: Sibuna
entities/sibuna.md.answer: Sibuna is an open-source web application firewall that makes clients solve a proof-of-work puzzle before reaching a website or API, then issues a signed session. For scrapers, it adds a compute cost per client and includes SQL injection, XSS, and path traversal checks, but TWSC has not tested it yet.

entities/simple-selenium-chrome-crawler..title: Simple Selenium Chrome Crawler: link extraction script
entities/simple-selenium-chrome-crawler..description: Python script using Selenium and Chrome that reads URLs from a file, visits each one, extracts links and saves them to a file. Not yet tested by TWSC.
entities/simple-selenium-chrome-crawler..name: Simple Selenium Chrome Crawler
entities/simple-selenium-chrome-crawler..answer: Simple Selenium Chrome Crawler is a Python script that uses Selenium and Chrome to crawl web pages and extract links. It reads URLs from a file, visits each one, and saves the links it finds to another file. TWSC has not yet tested it.

entities/slick-search-engine.md.title: Slick Search Engine: block and pin sites in search
entities/slick-search-engine.md.description: Slick is a search engine with its own crawl and ranking stack. Users block or pin domains, set recipes, and keep profiles with local preferences.
entities/slick-search-engine.md.name: Slick Search Engine
entities/slick-search-engine.md.answer: Slick Search Engine is a customizable search engine that runs its own crawl and ranking stack, with user rules layered on top. Users can block sites, pin domains, and keep separate profiles such as Shopping, Research, or Work, with preferences stored locally. TWSC has not tested it yet, so its scraping behavior is unknown.

entities/smartproxy-unblocker.md.title: Smartproxy Site Unblocker: anti-bot bypass test results
entities/smartproxy-unblocker.md.description: Smartproxy Site Unblocker at $12/GB: scored 80/100 in Hands-On #4, passed Cloudflare, DataDome, PerimeterX, and reached 92% on Kasada in 2024 tests.
entities/smartproxy-unblocker.md.name: Smartproxy Site Unblocker
entities/smartproxy-unblocker.md.answer: Smartproxy Site Unblocker is Smartproxy's managed anti-bot bypass API, priced at $12/GB during testing, below Oxylabs at $15/GB. It scored 80/100 in 2023, passing Cloudflare, DataDome, and PerimeterX but failing Kasada, then reached 92/100 on Kasada in June 2024, the lowest of the passing providers.

entities/socklight.md.title: sockLight: SOCKS5 dev proxy with live TUI to block traffic
entities/socklight.md.description: sockLight is a SOCKS5 dev proxy with a terminal UI to monitor, block and throttle connections live, no HTTPS decryption. Works with curl, wget, Docker.
entities/socklight.md.name: sockLight
entities/socklight.md.answer: sockLight is a development SOCKS5 proxy with a live terminal interface that lets you monitor, block, and throttle each outbound connection without installing certificates or decrypting HTTPS. It works at the connection level, so it cannot inspect or rewrite request bodies like mitmproxy, and TWSC has not yet tested it.

entities/socks5-bridge.md.title: socks5-bridge: SOCKS5 auth for Chrome via local proxy
entities/socks5-bridge.md.description: Local HTTP-to-SOCKS5 proxy bridge that gives Chrome authenticated SOCKS5. Covers how the listener, http_proxy, socks5 and relay modules work.
entities/socks5-bridge.md.name: socks5-bridge
entities/socks5-bridge.md.answer: socks5-bridge is a local HTTP-to-SOCKS5 proxy bridge for Chrome, which does not natively support SOCKS5 username/password authentication. Chrome connects to a loopback HTTP proxy and the bridge handles the authenticated SOCKS5 connection upstream; TWSC has not tested it yet, and setting allow_loopback_only to false calls for extreme caution.

entities/socks5-proxy.md.title: SOCKS5 proxy: egress allowlist and null byte bypass
entities/socks5-proxy.md.description: How a SOCKS5 proxy enforces an egress allowlist in Claude Code's sandbox, and how a null byte splits the JavaScript check from getaddrinfo().
entities/socks5-proxy.md.name: SOCKS5 proxy
entities/socks5-proxy.md.answer: SOCKS5 proxy is the component that Claude Code's sandbox uses to route outbound traffic and enforce an egress allowlist by checking hostnames in JavaScript. A null byte in a hostname can slip past that check, because getaddrinfo() stops at the null and resolves a different name. TWSC has not tested it.

entities/softpasskey.md.title: softpasskey: forging passkeys for automated WebAuthn logins
entities/softpasskey.md.description: A CLI tool that impersonates a FIDO2 device over USB-HID and forges passkey signatures via a Rust CTAP2 reimplementation for headless WebAuthn logins.
entities/softpasskey.md.name: softpasskey
entities/softpasskey.md.answer: softpasskey is a cross-platform CLI tool that registers a fake passkey and logs into websites without a physical security key by impersonating a FIDO2 device over USB-HID and forging passkey signatures. It reimplements the CTAP2 state machine in Rust with deterministic keys, enabling automated headless logins on WebAuthn sites; it has not yet been tested by TWSC.

entities/spidersuite.md.title: SpiderSuite: web crawler for security testing
entities/spidersuite.md.description: SpiderSuite is a security crawler with standard, headless, bruteforce, onion/TOR and links modes, plus HTTP(S) interception and fuzzing.
entities/spidersuite.md.name: SpiderSuite
entities/spidersuite.md.answer: SpiderSuite is a web crawler for security professionals, with standard, headless, bruteforce, onion/TOR, and links crawler modes, plus traffic interception, custom requests, and automated fuzzing. For scraping, the headless mode targets JS-heavy sites, but TWSC has not tested it, so its results against bot defenses are unknown.

entities/spidra.md.title: Spidra: AI web scraping platform with plain-English prompts
entities/spidra.md.description: Spidra is an AI scraping platform with a playground and API. Describe the data in plain English; it handles CAPTCHAs, proxies and exports to JSON or CSV.
entities/spidra.md.name: Spidra
entities/spidra.md.answer: Spidra is an AI web scraping platform where users give a URL and describe the data they want in plain English. It handles CAPTCHA solving, proxies, rate limits, anti-bot systems, and crawling, and exports JSON or CSV or sends data to Slack, Discord, webhooks, or databases. TWSC has not tested it yet.

entities/squid.md.title: Squid: network proxy for egress filtering and credentials
entities/squid.md.description: Squid is a network proxy server once used by IT admins to block sites. Covers egress traffic filtering, credential injection and transparent proxying.
entities/squid.md.name: Squid
entities/squid.md.answer: Squid is a network proxy server that IT administrators historically used to block sites seen as unproductive or out of bounds for education. It is involved in egress traffic filtering, credential injection and transparent proxying, but TWSC has not tested it, so no scraping results are reported.

entities/stalker.md.title: Stalker: browser and network fingerprint checker
entities/stalker.md.description: Stalker reports network, browser, display, fingerprint and privacy signals: public IP, OS, browser version, CPU cores, screen resolution and GPU vendor.
entities/stalker.md.name: Stalker
entities/stalker.md.answer: Stalker is a tool that checks and reports browser and network fingerprints for privacy and analysis. It collects signals such as public IP address, operating system, browser version, CPU cores, screen resolution, GPU vendor, and privacy settings, though TWSC has not yet tested it.

entities/stop-bots.md.title: stop-bots: block bots on your own server without a CDN
entities/stop-bots.md.description: stop-bots is a Rust TUI and CLI that configures nginx, Apache, Traefik, nftables and iptables to block bots, with preventative and responsive modes.
entities/stop-bots.md.name: stop-bots
entities/stop-bots.md.answer: stop-bots is a Rust TUI and CLI tool that configures web servers such as nginx, Apache, or Traefik, and firewalls such as nftables or iptables, to block malicious bots without a CDN. It has a preventative mode using bot lists and IP ranges, and a responsive mode that reads access logs. TWSC has not tested it yet.

entities/stratum-proxy.md.title: Stratum proxy: home solo Bitcoin mining proxy
entities/stratum-proxy.md.description: Stratum proxy forwards miner traffic to a pool and computes share difficulty from rebuilt block headers. Works with Bitaxe, NerdMiner, ESP32, cpuminer.
entities/stratum-proxy.md.name: Stratum proxy
entities/stratum-proxy.md.answer: Stratum proxy is a component for home solo Bitcoin mining that sits between miners such as Bitaxe, NerdMiner, ESP32 boards, and cpuminer and a Stratum V1 pool. It forwards traffic unchanged, computes each share's difficulty, and fails over to a backup pool. TWSC has not tested it for scraping.

entities/stunt.md.title: stunt: local mock servers that simulate public APIs
entities/stunt.md.description: stunt is a Go tool that runs stateful local stand-ins for APIs like Stripe, Drive, Dropbox, gRPC and GraphQL, with Starlark adapters in a sandboxed VM.
entities/stunt.md.name: stunt
entities/stunt.md.answer: stunt is a local simulator written in Go that runs stateful stand-ins for public APIs such as Stripe, Drive, Dropbox, gRPC services, and GraphQL APIs. It lets you test integrations without remote accounts, live credentials, or network access, though TWSC has not yet tested it.

entities/supercrawl.md.title: SuperCrawl: open-source web crawler written in Rust
entities/supercrawl.md.description: SuperCrawl is an open-source web crawler written in Rust, with a link to its GitHub repository. It has not yet been tested by The Web Scraping Club.
entities/supercrawl.md.name: SuperCrawl
entities/supercrawl.md.answer: SuperCrawl is an open-source web crawler written in Rust, with its code hosted on GitHub under AICrox2025. The source gives no detail on how it works, and TWSC has not tested it, so its blocking behavior, anti-bot handling, and fit for scraping jobs are unknown.

entities/supreme-bot.md.title: Supreme bot: automated buying via mobile endpoints
entities/supreme-bot.md.description: How a Supreme bot finds items in the mobile_stock.json endpoint, then fetches style and size, adds to cart and checks out. Not yet tested by TWSC.
entities/supreme-bot.md.name: Supreme bot
entities/supreme-bot.md.answer: Supreme bot is a tool that automates buying items from the Supreme website by using the mobile endpoints instead of parsing the page DOM. It finds an item ID in the mobile_stock.json endpoint, then adds to cart and checks out. TWSC has not tested it yet.

entities/tadpole.md.title: Tadpole: declarative language for modular web scrapers
entities/tadpole.md.description: Tadpole is a language for declarative, modular scraping code that hides browser interaction. Covers module imports, a CLI example on Redfin and KDL syntax.
entities/tadpole.md.name: Tadpole
entities/tadpole.md.answer: Tadpole is a language for writing declarative, modular scraping code that abstracts away browser interaction. Scripts can import modules from local files or remote repositories and run from the tadpole command line, with a Redfin example returning Seattle addresses, but The Web Scraping Wiki has not tested it yet.

entities/takion-api.md.title: Takion API: anti-bot bypass returning tokens and cookies
entities/takion-api.md.description: Takion API solves anti-bot challenges server-side and returns tokens and cookies. Covers supported vendors (Cloudflare, Akamai, DataDome) and proxy use.
entities/takion-api.md.name: Takion API
entities/takion-api.md.answer: Takion API is a managed bypass service that solves anti-bot challenges server-side and returns tokens and cookies, so later requests get through without a headless browser. It covers Cloudflare, Akamai, DataDome, and others with one key and one POST per solve, but TWSC has not tested it yet.

entities/tanuki.md.title: Tanuki: anonymization proxy for AI security testing
entities/tanuki.md.description: Tanuki is a Docker proxy that swaps real domains, IPs, emails and cloud IDs for fictional ones before prompts reach an LLM API, then restores them.
entities/tanuki.md.name: Tanuki
entities/tanuki.md.answer: Tanuki is an anonymization proxy, run as a Docker container, that swaps real target data such as domains, IPs, emails, and cloud identifiers for fictional equivalents before prompts reach an LLM API. It rewrites responses back to real values so local tools hit actual targets. TWSC has not tested it yet.

entities/telltale-bot.md.title: Telltale Bot: human, AI agent and bot detection
entities/telltale-bot.md.description: Telltale Bot classifies visitors as human, AI agent or bot with a JavaScript tag and 50+ signals, sends verdicts to GA4 and GTM, and misses non-JS crawlers.
entities/telltale-bot.md.name: Telltale Bot
entities/telltale-bot.md.answer: Telltale Bot is a service that classifies website visitors as human, AI agent, or bot, using a JavaScript tag plus server-side connection data across more than 50 signals. It only sees visitors that execute JavaScript, so most crawlers fall outside its reach, and TWSC has not tested it yet.

entities/ticket-js.md.title: ticket.js: Supreme ntbcc cookie fingerprint and bypass
entities/ticket-js.md.description: How Supreme's ticket.js built the ntbcc cookie from webdriver, canvas and media playback checks, and what was needed to forge it.
entities/ticket-js.md.name: ticket.js
entities/ticket-js.md.answer: ticket.js was an anti-bot system Supreme used in its Spring 2021 season, generating an encrypted `ntbcc` cookie from browser challenge fingerprints. Bypassing it meant obtaining the `/live.json` token key, the fingerprint, and the cookie key, and new versions per drop limited how long they stayed valid. TWSC has not tested it.

entities/tilefinch.md.title: Tilefinch: browser project for rendering heavy scripts
entities/tilefinch.md.description: Tilefinch is a browser project admitting large scripts and styles within measured memory bounds to cut pauses on JavaScript-heavy pages. Untested by TWSC.
entities/tilefinch.md.name: Tilefinch
entities/tilefinch.md.answer: Tilefinch is a project that aims to improve page rendering on complex, JavaScript-heavy websites by admitting large scripts and styles within measured memory bounds, which is meant to reduce pauses and repeated work. It has not yet been tested by TWSC, so there are no reported results on blocking or scraping success.

entities/torgrid.md.title: TorGrid: rotating Tor exit proxy pool, SOCKS5 and HTTP
entities/torgrid.md.description: TorGrid is a self-healing rotating Tor proxy pool with 100 to 1,100 exit IPs. Covers SOCKS5 and HTTP ports, Android split-tunnel VPN and obfs4 bridges.
entities/torgrid.md.name: TorGrid
entities/torgrid.md.answer: TorGrid is a self-healing, rotating proxy pool that exposes many Tor exit IPs through a local SOCKS5 and HTTP gateway, with an Android split-tunnel VPN mode. For scrapers it rotates the exit IP per request and heals dead circuits, with grids of 100 to 1,100 IPs. TWSC has not tested it yet.

entities/tpb-run.md.title: TPB.Run: Pirate Bay proxy site that bypasses ISP blocks
entities/tpb-run.md.description: TPB.Run is a retro-themed proxy site for The Pirate Bay. The page explains how it fetches and rewrites links to get around regional and ISP blocks.
entities/tpb-run.md.name: TPB.Run
entities/tpb-run.md.answer: TPB.Run is a proxy website for The Pirate Bay with a retro theme, described as very fast, meant to get around geographical restrictions and ISP blocks. It fetches pages from The Pirate Bay and rewrites links to point back to itself. TWSC has not tested it yet.

entities/transparenttorproxy.md.title: TransparentTorProxy: route Linux traffic through Tor
entities/transparenttorproxy.md.description: Linux CLI that sends all system traffic through Tor with nftables. Covers IP rotation, DNS and IPv6 leak prevention, atomic rules and a crash-safe lock file.
entities/transparenttorproxy.md.name: TransparentTorProxy
entities/transparenttorproxy.md.answer: TransparentTorProxy is a Linux command-line utility that uses nftables to route all system traffic through the Tor network, with DNS and IPv6 configured to prevent leaks. It supports IP rotation and global proxy toggling for privacy tasks, but TWSC has not tested it yet, so scraping results are unknown.

entities/twitter-generator.md.title: twitter-generator: generate X login headers in Python
entities/twitter-generator.md.description: Python module that rebuilds X (Twitter) login headers: X-Client-Transaction-Id, X-Guest-Token and X-Xp-Forwarded-For (WASM). Not yet tested by TWSC.
entities/twitter-generator.md.name: twitter-generator
entities/twitter-generator.md.answer: twitter-generator is a Python module that reverse-engineers and replicates X (formerly Twitter) login headers so automation can run without a browser. It rebuilds X-Client-Transaction-Id, X-Guest-Token, and X-Xp-Forwarded-For, the last one requiring analysis of a WebAssembly script. TWSC has not tested it yet.

entities/uaparser-js.md.title: UAParser.js: parse user agents and client hints
entities/uaparser-js.md.description: UAParser.js is a library that parses the user agent string or client hints header to get browser, OS and version. Not yet tested by TWSC.
entities/uaparser-js.md.name: UAParser.js
entities/uaparser-js.md.answer: UAParser.js is an existing library that parses the user agent string or client hints HTTP header to identify a visitor's browser, operating system, and their versions. Scrapers can use it to check what a given user agent claims to be, though TWSC has not yet tested it.

entities/underclass.md.title: underclass: local proxy pooling ChatGPT and Copilot
entities/underclass.md.description: underclass is a local OpenAI-compatible proxy that pools ChatGPT/Codex and GitHub Copilot subscriptions, with sticky sessions and quota cooldowns.
entities/underclass.md.name: underclass
entities/underclass.md.answer: underclass is a local, OpenAI-compatible proxy that pools several subscriptions, such as ChatGPT/Codex and GitHub Copilot, behind one endpoint. It pins sessions to an account by `prompt_cache_key` and cools down exhausted accounts, returning the earliest `Retry-After` when all are cooling, but it has not yet been tested by TWSC.

entities/undetected-chromedriver.md.title: undetected-chromedriver: patched Selenium for stealth
entities/undetected-chromedriver.md.description: How undetected-chromedriver patches ChromeDriver, its results against Cloudflare, Datadome and Kasada, Harrods and Indeed, and successors like Nodriver.
entities/undetected-chromedriver.md.name: undetected-chromedriver
entities/undetected-chromedriver.md.answer: undetected-chromedriver is a patched Selenium ChromeDriver that hides obvious WebDriver signals, and it was a widely recommended open-source stealth tool around 2022 and 2023. In reported tests it worked against 4 of 5 anti-bot systems locally, failed from datacenter IPs, and in 2026 got 89% at Harrods but 0% at Indeed.

entities/usehuma.md.title: useHUMA: behavioral bot detection and its neutral-score gap
entities/usehuma.md.description: useHUMA scores mouse movement, keystroke cadence, scroll rhythm and touch without CAPTCHAs or PII. Covers the neutral score bots got with only a userId.
entities/usehuma.md.name: useHUMA
entities/usehuma.md.answer: useHUMA is an anti-bot startup that scores behavior such as mouse movement, keystroke cadence, scroll rhythm, and touch patterns, without CAPTCHAs, puzzles, or PII. When called without behavioral signals, such as only a userId, it returned a neutral score that cleared the threshold and let bots through. TWSC has not tested it.

entities/vericto-proxy.md.title: Vericto Proxy: SQL wire proxy blocking destructive queries
entities/vericto-proxy.md.description: Vericto Proxy is a PostgreSQL and MySQL wire-protocol proxy that parses queries with vericto-engine and blocks destructive SQL. Covers limits and dialects.
entities/vericto-proxy.md.name: Vericto Proxy
entities/vericto-proxy.md.answer: Vericto Proxy is a transparent wire-protocol proxy that parses each query with the vericto-engine and blocks destructive SQL before it reaches PostgreSQL or MySQL, with no application code changes. It is a database safeguard, not a scraping tool, and TWSC has not tested it. Other dialects need the HTTP API, CLI, or MCP.

entities/violens.md.title: VioLens: open-source Fiddler Classic successor proxy
entities/violens.md.description: VioLens is an MIT-licensed HTTP/HTTPS debugging proxy for Windows, macOS and Linux. Covers HTTPS decryption, HTTP/2 and WebSocket views, and TextWizard.
entities/violens.md.name: VioLens
entities/violens.md.answer: VioLens is an open-source, MIT-licensed HTTP/HTTPS debugging proxy meant as a successor to Fiddler Classic, running on Windows, macOS, and Linux. It decrypts HTTPS through an installed root certificate and handles HTTP/2 and WebSocket, but TWSC has not tested it, and version 1.0 is still a release candidate.

entities/vnc2go.md.title: VNC2Go: private in-browser proxy with 10-minute sessions
entities/vnc2go.md.description: VNC2Go is a private, in-browser service that routes traffic through a random proxy. The page covers how it works and its 10-minute session limit.
entities/vnc2go.md.name: VNC2Go
entities/vnc2go.md.answer: VNC2Go is a private, in-browser service that routes traffic through a random proxy. For scraping, the page reports one limit: sessions last 10 minutes, so it suits short manual browsing through a proxy and not long-running jobs. No test results are reported.

entities/vpndetection.md.title: VPNDetection: IP API for VPN, proxy and Tor detection
entities/vpndetection.md.description: VPNDetection classifies IPs as VPN, hosting, Tor, CDN, privacy relay or proxy (residential, datacenter, mobile, public), via API or daily MMDB databases.
entities/vpndetection.md.name: VPNDetection
entities/vpndetection.md.answer: VPNDetection is an IP classification service that flags addresses as VPN, hosting, Tor, CDN, privacy relay, or residential, datacenter, mobile and public proxy, with operator name, last-seen time and confidence. Scrapers can query its API or run its daily-updated CSVGZ or MMDB databases locally, but TWSC has not tested it yet.

entities/web-bot-auth.md.title: Web Bot Auth: crawler authentication with RFC 9421
entities/web-bot-auth.md.description: Web Bot Auth lets Cloudflare verify a crawler through RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures and a published key directory, with a key-by-key check.
entities/web-bot-auth.md.name: Web Bot Auth
entities/web-bot-auth.md.answer: Web Bot Auth is a system built on RFC 9421 and HTTP Message Signatures that lets a verifier such as Cloudflare authenticate a crawler from a signing-key directory the operator publishes. A checker tool looks for /.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory and tests each key for mistakes that stop verification, including a leaked private key.

entities/webassembly-simd.md.title: WebAssembly SIMD: browser CPU fingerprinting by timing
entities/webassembly-simd.md.description: How SIMD instruction latency identifies a CPU from the browser: V8 and JSC accuracy, spoofing limits, and what it means for scrapers on cloud servers.
entities/webassembly-simd.md.name: WebAssembly SIMD
entities/webassembly-simd.md.answer: WebAssembly SIMD is a set of vector instructions whose browser-measured latency can fingerprint the host CPU. In Manikhouth's May 2026 research across 2,124 devices, it identified CPU models with 82.1% accuracy in V8 and exposed server CPUs behind fake consumer devices, but it is still a proof of concept and TWSC has not tested it.

entities/webcrack.md.title: Webcrack: deobfuscating JavaScript with CDP hooks
entities/webcrack.md.description: Webcrack helps reverse-engineer obfuscated JavaScript by hooking functions like Array.prototype.push through CDP script injection before page code runs.
entities/webcrack.md.name: Webcrack
entities/webcrack.md.answer: Webcrack is a tool that helps reverse-engineer web pages by deobfuscating JavaScript. It uses the Chrome DevTools Protocol to inject scripts before page code runs and hooks native functions such as Array.prototype.push to trace obfuscated code. TWSC has not tested it yet.

entities/webone.md.title: WebOne: HTTP 1.x proxy for old browsers on modern web
entities/webone.md.description: WebOne is an HTTP 1.x proxy that adapts HTTPS traffic for legacy browsers like Netscape 3. Covers MITM decryption, protocol conversion and security limits.
entities/webone.md.name: WebOne
entities/webone.md.answer: WebOne is an HTTP 1.x proxy server that lets older browsers, media players, and messengers work with the modern web by decrypting HTTPS and converting between HTTPS 1.1 and HTTP 1.0. It is not built for scraping and has not been tested by TWSC; the developers warn that stripping encryption and using old browsers can create security problems.

entities/who-1ms-dog.md.title: who.1ms.dog: browser fingerprint test and signals shown
entities/who-1ms-dog.md.description: who.1ms.dog shows the signals behind a browser fingerprint: IP, language, screen, fonts, TLS and HTTP. Includes the in-app browser caveat.
entities/who-1ms-dog.md.name: who.1ms.dog
entities/who-1ms-dog.md.answer: who.1ms.dog is a website from 1ms.dog that shows the browser fingerprinting signals a site can collect, including IP address, language, screen resolution, fonts, and TLS/HTTP fingerprints. Scrapers can use it to check what their setup exposes, though TWSC has not tested it, and in-app browsers will report their own fingerprint.

entities/wick.md.title: Wick: local tool giving AI agents browser-like access
entities/wick.md.description: Wick is an open-source local service that fetches pages for AI agents with browser networking, your IP and cookies, and returns markdown. Not yet tested.
entities/wick.md.name: Wick
entities/wick.md.answer: Wick is an open-source tool that lets AI agents fetch web pages as a real browser would, running as a lightweight local service with your own IP and cookies. It returns clean markdown and aims to avoid 403 errors and CAPTCHA walls, but TWSC has not tested it yet.

entities/wirepane.md.title: Wirepane: HTTPS debugging proxy for Claude Code
entities/wirepane.md.description: Wirepane is an HTTPS debugging proxy for Claude Code that decrypts HTTP/2, gRPC and WebSockets traffic, with a rules engine for mocks and breakpoints.
entities/wirepane.md.name: Wirepane
entities/wirepane.md.answer: Wirepane is an HTTPS debugging proxy built to run inside Claude Code, an alternative to Proxyman or Charles. It decrypts traffic from browsers, iOS Simulators, iPhones, and Android devices, and its rules engine can mock, delay, or rewrite requests, though TWSC has not tested it yet.

entities/wmimo.md.title: Wmimo: Flutter GUI client for Clash and Mihomo proxies
entities/wmimo.md.description: Wmimo is a Flutter GUI client for Clash and Mihomo on desktop and mobile. Covers supported protocols, Rule/Global/Direct modes and TUN or system proxy.
entities/wmimo.md.name: Wmimo
entities/wmimo.md.answer: Wmimo is a cross-platform Flutter GUI client for managing Clash and Mihomo proxy configurations on desktop and mobile, built on the Mihomo core. It supports protocols such as VLESS (Reality), Trojan, Hysteria 2 and WireGuard, with Rule, Global and Direct routing, but TWSC has not tested it yet.

entities/wxpath.md.title: wxpath: declarative recursive crawling with XPath in Python
entities/wxpath.md.description: wxpath is a Python library that describes crawling and extraction in one XPath expression, using the url() operator and /// for recursive, max_depth crawls.
entities/wxpath.md.name: wxpath
entities/wxpath.md.answer: wxpath is a Python library for declarative web crawling with XPath, where one expression describes both traversal and extraction. Its url(...) operator and /// syntax handle recursive or paginated crawls up to a max_depth without hand-written crawl loops, but TWSC has not tested it yet.

entities/x-twitter-ui-metrics.md.title: x-twitter-ui-metrics: bypass X's ui_metrics challenge
entities/x-twitter-ui-metrics.md.description: GitHub repo with Node.js, Go and Python code that rebuilds X's ui_metrics login challenge: the js_inst script and its obfuscation patterns, no browser.
entities/x-twitter-ui-metrics.md.name: x-twitter-ui-metrics
entities/x-twitter-ui-metrics.md.answer: x-twitter-ui-metrics is a GitHub repository with Node.js, Go, and Python code that reconstructs X's UI metrics login challenge, a dynamic obfuscated script that fills a hidden ui_metrics field. It lets a scraper run the logic natively without a browser, but TWSC has not tested it yet.

entities/xcancel-com-antibot-captcha.md.title: xcancel.com/antibot/captcha: image CAPTCHA challenge
entities/xcancel-com-antibot-captcha.md.description: Page for the xcancel.com antibot CAPTCHA: users type the coloured characters shown in an image, then retry or get a new image. Not yet tested by TWSC.
entities/xcancel-com-antibot-captcha.md.name: xcancel.com/antibot/captcha
entities/xcancel-com-antibot-captcha.md.answer: xcancel.com/antibot/captcha is a CAPTCHA page that asks users to type the coloured characters shown in an image. If the entry does not match, it offers a retry or a new image. TWSC has not tested it yet, so no bypass results are reported.

entities/xtreme-download-manager-xdm.md.title: Xtreme Download Manager (XDM): video and file downloader
entities/xtreme-download-manager-xdm.md.description: XDM splits files across multiple connections, resumes broken downloads and grabs HLS and MPEG-DASH video through a browser extension. Not yet tested by TWSC.
entities/xtreme-download-manager-xdm.md.name: Xtreme Download Manager (XDM)
entities/xtreme-download-manager-xdm.md.answer: Xtreme Download Manager (XDM) is a download accelerator and video downloader that splits files into segments fetched concurrently, resumes broken downloads, and supports HLS and MPEG-DASH streams through a browser extension. TWSC has not tested it yet, and the project is being rewritten, so its codebase changes often.

entities/zenrows-batch.md.title: Zenrows Batch: async API for scraping large URL lists
entities/zenrows-batch.md.description: Zenrows Batch is an async scraping API that queues URL lists as one job, with mode=auto, transient retries, webhook or polling results, and CSV upload.
entities/zenrows-batch.md.name: ZenRows Batch
entities/zenrows-batch.md.answer: ZenRows Batch is an asynchronous scraping API that takes a list of URLs and one scraping configuration, then runs them as a single managed job with queuing, concurrency, retries, and result delivery. For scrapers, it returns a job ID with webhook or polling updates, though TWSC has not tested it yet.

entities/zyte-api.md.title: Zyte API: web unblocker, rendering modes and test results
entities/zyte-api.md.description: Zyte API is a managed web unblocker with raw HTTP and browser rendering modes. Covers TWSC scores, Cloudflare and Kasada results, and per-request pricing.
entities/zyte-api.md.name: Zyte API
entities/zyte-api.md.answer: Zyte API is a managed web unblocker from Zyte, the company behind Scrapy, offering anti-bot bypass, IP rotation, and optional browser rendering through one endpoint. It scored 100/100 with rendering and 81/100 in raw HTTP mode in Hands-On #2, passed Cloudflare, and failed Kasada in both Kasada tests.

timelines/cloudflare-bypass-evolution.md.title: Cloudflare bypass evolution: what worked, what failed
timelines/cloudflare-bypass-evolution.md.description: Timeline of Cloudflare bypass tests from 2022 to 2026: Turnstile, TLS impersonation, fingerprint injection, Nodriver, Camoufox, Scrapling and web unblockers.
timelines/cloudflare-bypass-evolution.md.name: Cloudflare bypass evolution
timelines/cloudflare-bypass-evolution.md.answer: Cloudflare bypass evolution is a timeline of what worked against Cloudflare from 2022 to early 2026, based on TWSC testing. Firefox-based tools like Camoufox and Scrapling with residential proxies now handle most configurations, while Chrome-based stealth tools such as undetected-chromedriver and Pydoll increasingly fail on strict targets like Indeed.
